possibleSystematicExtractionGaps: The requested data/agent_library README, manifest, and proposal-template files are absent from current main, so the exact proposal schema could not be loaded.

data/google_inventory_detail_evidence.json is a roughly 1.9 MB merged evidence artifact. Its full content could not be safely expanded through the connected repository response path in this pass; five assigned rows therefore remain blocked where the batch plan says F coverage exists but no concrete dish provenance is visible in source_facts/source_enrichment.

The Hot Pepper promotional miner writes retained_hotpepper_promotional_dish_evidence.json to a work directory, but no committed data/retained_hotpepper_promotional_dish_evidence.json artifact exists on current main. Exact Hot Pepper branch bindings therefore do not by themselves prove dish text.

For 花臨蘭州牛肉麺 and 馬さん餃子酒場 神保町店, the batch plan reports two featured dishes while the directly inspectable provider source fact retains only one concrete dish. The unrecovered extra item is deliberately omitted.

data/featured_dishes.js explicitly mixes source-backed recommended-or-representative menu facts and does not imply recommendation semantics for every item; no featured item was promoted to R without separate recommendation wording.
Overture Maps contact records were used only for exact identity/provenance checks and never as dish evidence.
